response.sql: WITH status_avgs AS (SELECT t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) as avg_pulse_rate FROM signals s INNER JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry WHERE s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.equipstatus), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) as mean_rate FROM status_avgs), above_first_mean AS (SELECT sa.equipstatus, sa.avg_pulse_rate, sa.avg_pulse_rate - fm.mean_rate as excess_over_first FROM status_avgs sa, first_mean fm WHERE sa.avg_pulse_rate > fm.mean_rate), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) as mean_rate FROM above_first_mean), above_second_mean AS (SELECT afm.equipstatus, afm.avg_pulse_rate, afm.excess_over_first, afm.avg_pulse_rate - sm.mean_rate as excess_over_second FROM above_first_mean afm, second_mean sm WHERE afm.avg_pulse_rate > sm.mean_rate) SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) as final_avg_pulse_rate, AVG(excess_over_first) as avg_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(excess_over_second) as avg_excess_over_second_mean FROM above_second_mean
